componentForm.extraOnlyTooltip: If enabled, this component will only be applied when the shift is extra (assigned outside the regular rotation). Can be combined with any other condition.

guide.title: Rate System Guide
guide.subtitle: Learn how VITA's flexible rate system works and how to create rate templates with custom components.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: VITA's rate system lets you define exactly how your staff gets paid. Instead of a flat rate, you can combine multiple components to reflect your actual salary structure.
overview.templateDesc: A reusable set of payment rules that you define once and assign to multiple people.
overview.componentDesc: Each individual piece of the calculation: base salary, bonuses, multipliers, etc.
overview.contractDesc: The link between a person and a rate template, with start date and optional multiplier.

step1.title: Create a Template
step1.description: Define the name and add payment components based on the position's needs.

step2.title: Configure Components
step2.description: For each component, choose the type, amount, unit, and when it applies.

step3.title: Assign to Staff
step3.description: Link the template to each person by creating a contract with an optional multiplier.

step4.title: Automatic Calculation
step4.description: VITA calculates the payment for each shift based on the applicable components.

componentTypes.title: Component Types
componentTypes.description: VITA includes 19 predefined component types grouped into 4 main categories.

fixed.title: Fixed Payments
fixed.description: Amounts paid regularly, independent of shifts.
fixed.baseSalary: Fixed monthly, biweekly, or weekly salary
fixed.perShift: Fixed amount for each completed shift
fixed.completionBonus: Extra bonus for completing the full shift

timeBased.title: Time-Based Payments
timeBased.description: Calculated based on actual time worked.

bonuses.title: Conditional Bonuses
bonuses.description: Additional amounts applied under specific conditions.
bonuses.weekend: Extra for working Saturday or Sunday
bonuses.area: Extra for working in specific areas

multipliers.title: Multipliers
multipliers.description: Factors that multiply the base amount based on the shift context.
multipliers.night: Multiplies base pay during night hours

custom.title: Custom
custom.description: Create custom components with your own name and rules for unique cases in your organization.

units.title: Payment Units
units.description: Each component has a unit that defines how its value is calculated.
units.periodicDesc: Monthly, Biweekly, Weekly, Daily — regular payments independent of shifts.
units.eventBasedDesc: Per Shift, Per Minute, Per Hour — calculated when the person works.
units.calculatedDesc: Percentage, Multiplier, Fixed Amount — applied on top of other base values.

conditions.title: Apply Conditions
conditions.description: Each component can have a condition that determines when it applies.
conditions.holiday: Only applies on holidays marked in the calendar
conditions.irrenunciable: Only on mandatory holidays (Christmas, New Year, etc.)
conditions.overtime: Only applies to extra hours beyond the scheduled shift
conditions.shiftType: Only applies to specific shift types you choose

problem.title: Excel wasn't designed to manage shifts
problem.description: If you're still using spreadsheets, legacy systems, or WhatsApp to coordinate shifts, you're losing time, money, and peace of mind.

pain1.title: Constant manual errors
pain1.description: Copy-pasting shifts between cells creates conflicts, duplications, and uncovered positions.

pain2.title: No real-time visibility
pain2.description: Nobody knows who's working right now. Changes get lost between file versions.

pain3.title: Complex pay calculations
pain3.description: Overtime, night shifts, holidays, bonuses... calculating each component by hand is a headache.

pain4.title: Legal compliance risk
pain4.description: Labor law requires minimum rest periods and hour limits. Without a system, compliance is a gamble.

features.title: Everything you need to manage shifts
features.description: A complete platform that replaces spreadsheets, legacy systems, and WhatsApp groups.

feature1.title: Digital Calendar
feature1.description: View and manage all your organization's shifts in an interactive calendar with daily, weekly, and monthly views.

feature2.title: Automatic Pay Calculation
feature2.description: Define flexible rate components and let VITA automatically calculate the pay for each shift.

feature3.title: Legal Compliance
feature3.description: Automatic validations based on Chilean Labor Code: rest periods, hour limits, and restrictions.

faq.title: Have questions? We've got answers
faq.q1: What types of organizations can use VITA?
faq.a1: VITA is designed for any organization that works with shifts: hospitals, clinics, medical centers, security companies, retail, and more. Our focus is on healthcare, but the platform is flexible.
faq.q2: Do I need to install anything on my computers?
faq.a2: No. VITA is 100% cloud-based. You just need an updated web browser. No installation, no own servers, no special hardware required.
faq.a3: You define rate components (base, night shifts, holidays, overtime, bonuses, etc.) and VITA automatically calculates the payment for each shift according to the rules you set up.
faq.q4: Does VITA comply with Chilean labor law?
faq.a4: Yes. VITA includes validations based on Chile's Labor Code: minimum rest between shifts, weekly hour limits, night shift restrictions, and more.
faq.q5: Can I migrate my data from Excel?
faq.a5: Yes. We offer assistance to migrate your information from existing spreadsheets to VITA. Our team supports you throughout the process.
faq.q6: How long does it take to implement VITA?
faq.a6: Basic setup takes less than an hour. For large organizations with multiple areas and complex rates, we offer assisted implementation in 1-2 weeks.
faq.a7: Absolutely. We use enterprise-level encryption, secure servers, and comply with data protection regulations. Your data is never shared with third parties.
faq.q8: Do you offer a trial period?
faq.a8: Yes. We offer a personalized demo and a trial period so you can evaluate the platform with your real team before committing.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: At VITA, we take your data privacy very seriously. This policy describes how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.

section1.title: 1. Information We Collect
section1.content: We collect information you provide directly when creating an account, such as your name, email, organization, and professional data. We also collect service usage data to improve the platform.

section2.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
section2.content: We use your information to provide and improve our services, process shifts and pay calculations, send relevant notifications, and comply with legal obligations.

section3.title: 3. Data Protection
section3.content: We implement technical and organizational security measures to protect your data, including encryption in transit and at rest, restricted access, and regular audits.

section4.title: 4. Data Sharing
section4.content: We do not sell or share your personal data with third parties, except when necessary to provide the service (infrastructure providers) or when required by law.

section5.title: 5. Your Rights
section5.content: You have the right to access, rectify, delete, and port your personal data. You can exercise these rights by contacting us at any time.

section6.title: 6. Contact
section6.content: For privacy inquiries, write to us at privacy@vita-shifts.com.

termsPage.title: Terms of Service
termsPage.intro: By using VITA, you agree to the following terms and conditions. Please read them carefully.

section1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
section1.content: By accessing or using VITA, you agree to be bound by these terms of service. If you do not agree, you must not use the platform.

section2.title: 2. Service Description
section2.content: VITA is a SaaS shift management platform that enables organizations to plan, assign, and manage work shifts, calculate payments, and comply with labor legislation.

section3.title: 3. User Accounts
section3.content: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account and password. You must notify us immediately if you detect unauthorized use of your account.

section4.title: 4. Acceptable Use
section4.content: You agree to use VITA only for legitimate shift management purposes. You must not attempt to access other organizations' data or compromise system security.

section5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
section5.content: VITA and all its content, features, and functionality are the exclusive property of its creators. No license is granted over the source code or intellectual property.

section6.title: 6. Limitation of Liability
section6.content: VITA is provided "as is". We do not guarantee that the service will be uninterrupted or error-free. Our liability is limited to the amount paid for the service in the last 12 months.

section7.title: 7. Contact
